classification.difficultyReason: Represent inequalities with appropriate open or closed endpoints and bounded segments or unbounded rays.

content.prompt: Graph these intervals on the real number line.

answer.short: Closed endpoint at $2$; ray extending left.
answer.worked: Include $2$ with a closed circle and draw a ray to the left for all values less than $2$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2a; teacher PDF page 6, printed page 754
spec.description: Complete interval solution. Custom TikZ retains a raised interval ray, which the supplied number-line template does not express.
spec.mathematics: All real x less than or equal to 2; closed endpoint at 2 and left ray; integer ticks -3 to 3.

answer.short: Open endpoint at $-1$; ray extending right.
answer.worked: Exclude $-1$ with an open circle and draw a ray to the right for all greater values.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2b; teacher PDF page 6, printed page 754
spec.description: Complete interval solution; raised ray requires custom TikZ.
spec.mathematics: All real x greater than -1; open endpoint at -1 and right ray; integer ticks -3 to 3.

answer.short: Open endpoint at $-2$, closed endpoint at $5$; join them.
answer.worked: Draw an open circle at $-2$ and a closed circle at $5$. Join them with a segment to show every value between the endpoints.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2c; teacher PDF page 6, printed page 754
spec.description: Complete interval solution; raised interval segment requires custom TikZ.
spec.mathematics: Open endpoint -2, closed endpoint 5 and connecting segment; integer ticks -2 to 5.
